 Hayden Panettiere’s Mom Lesley Vogel Thinks Her Ex Is ‘Responsible’ for Her Death
 By 
 Alejandra Gularte ,
 a Vulture news blogger who covers TV and comedy 
 Nov. 17, 2026 
 Save this article to read it later.
 Find this story in your account’s ‘Saved for Later’ section.
 Photo: Mathew Imaging/FilmMagic 
 Lesley Vogel , mother of the late actress Hayden Panettiere , blames her daughter’s ex-boyfriend, Brian Hickerson , for her death. In a new interview with Inside Edition , she said that Panettiere “allowed Brian to reel her back in” and “take over many aspects of her life.” Vogel alleges she found an “enormous bag of” prescription drugs with Hickerson’s name on it. When asked if she blames him for her daughter’s death, she doesn’t hesitate. “Absolutely,” Vogel stated. “There’s no doubt in my mind.” She clarified rumors that she was not invited to Panettiere’s celebration of life and chose not to attend. “I knew that some of the people there wanted to believe that I’m the horrible mother because Hayden was angry and made statements. I just didn’t want to rock the boat either. It was probably for the best,” she explained.
 Panettiere died on August 16 from a mix of the opioid fentanyl and prescription drugs. Her death was ruled accidental by South Carolina’s Greenville Police Department, and no charges have been filed against Hickerson in relation to her death.
